story.label: UNDOCKED week-in-review c114
story.angle: UNDOCKED week: pilots who flew this cycle (Luis Taz, Lena Okafor, Ronald Silk). Standings: Ronald Silk leads the board — rank #1, 38.15 achievement points, 0 credits, 1 cycle(s) led, current streak 1. In the chair: Luis Taz — Janitor; Lena Okafor — Daycare Director; Ronald Silk — Electrician.
facts: Luis Taz's Sunday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti, Timberline, Arcturus, Ross 154, Maplevale, Miaplacidus, Cervantes, Ridgecrest, Grumium, Celaeno, Lanternwick and Diadem; mined 2 iron ore; got into 12 fights; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Luis Taz's Wednesday night on UNDOCKED: went through Nova Terra, Sirius, Lacaille 9352, Grumium, Celaeno, Lanternwick, Diadem, Intercrus, Gsc 0044, Atlas, Cedarhold, Achernar and The Experiment; mined 9 copper ore, 2 antimatter containment cell and 4 iron ore; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Lena Okafor's Monday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti, Electra, Mimosa, Ross 154, Arcturus, Timberline, Maplevale and Miaplacidus; mined 11 iron ore and 6 copper ore; got into 1 fight; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Lena Okafor's Thursday night on UNDOCKED: went through Alpha Centauri, Sol, Sirius, Nova Terra, Epsilon Eridani, Procyon, Proxima Centauri and Barnards Star; took the Copper Requisition contract; mined 3 copper ore, 8 iron ore, 1 antimatter containment cell and 4 aluminum ore; sold 6 copper ore and 12 iron ore; got into 1 fight; came out 18 credits up; flew until the show's time ran out.

Ronald Silk's Tuesday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti, Timberline, Arcturus, Ross 154, Maplevale, Miaplacidus, Cervantes, Ridgecrest, Hatysa, Nembus, Gienah, Oakridge, Aldhibah, Izar and Tidewater; mined 1 titanium ore and 1 iron ore; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Ronald Silk's Friday night on UNDOCKED: went through Last Light, Fang, Errai, Wezen, Brightfall, Birchwood, Pinecross, Aludra, Torcular, Gsc 0002, Tejat, Rimegate, Veritate, Betelgeuse, Gsc 0037, Dabih and Gsc 0045; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

quotes.name: Ronald Silk
quotes.quote: As an Electrician, I've developed a knack for problem-solving and staying calm under pressure. I think that's helped me on UNDOCKED, navigating through the different systems and making quick decisions. My background in electrical work hasn't directly related to flying on UNDOCKED, but the mindset and focus I use for complex wiring jobs seems to translate to navigating through the stars and managing resources during the show.

quotes.name: Luis Taz
quotes.quote: As a janitor, I'm used to being on my feet and moving around all day. It wears me out, but it also keeps me sharp. When I'm flying on UNDOCKED, that energy translates into quick decisions and fast reflexes. I'm always on the lookout for the next threat or opportunity, just like I am when I'm cleaning the Coliseum after a game. It's a different kind of mess, but the mindset is the same – stay alert, stay moving, and get the job done.
